about: What the Rust CLI's core config port (cli/crates/gl-coreconfig) is held to, written from the app's own builder
(sharedUI net/core) and held to it by CoreInputVectorsTest. Each case is a fixture link of a kind under
net/core/lines, the spec the app's link parser reads from it, and the reference config the app writes for it
under Global with the fixture login on the default port. A plan's config is in core-plans/<name>.json.
A spec is OutboundSpec as JSON: every field, null where it is absent. The crate's vectors.sha256 lists every
file here and every reference a case names: a change to any of them changes it, and so runs the Rust tests.
